cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you send this soup back, did you notice anything moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm complaining about cold noodles. What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Tell me whether one waved. I need your word before I explain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It waved me closer. I'm still not eating it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll understand why I've ordered it lunch. Could you ask whether it wants your bread?

mechanism: A turns its pupil menu-reading observations into a demand for independent confirmation before admitting it has treated a noodle as a diner.
confusable: Not announcing belief and seeking agreement afterward: A withholds the ordered lunch until B confirms the specific impossible gesture.
comparison: Controlled chronology report versus confirming food invitation despite complaint.
seedUse: D160 cold noodles/wave/closer/lunch/bread; S05 careful observation before verdict.
